notes: Craft: the cope scene lays out all five encountered image-families (Mary, rabbits/angels, wheels, wings, eagle) so the later corrected scenes visibly re-read the same encounter. Correction-vs-elaboration authority from the dialogue source is carried into the hm table verbatim.

#0 cope — the five image-families of the cope laid out as encountered: ☽ (Mary lifted) rises through the field, the perceived figure alternates angel/rabbit (the ambiguity staged as the sign's own alternation, its authority difference in tint), the wheels ring turns a quarter-turn (orientation changing, form persisting), ⚔ wings and 🦅 eagle at the corners; a slow cope-breath LFO on turbulence; pointer attract — the gathering of images.

#1 chiasm — the receiving ∨ flips to the received ∧ and the pair crosses into ✕ (the chiasm staged as the signs' own union); the ⚠ stays bright (Jung's worry kept); pointer attract/implode — the return receiving.

#3 wings — grid layout: the wheel sequence walks 0/1→1/0 into its compound (0/1)/(1/0); ⊘ dims twice (the corrected pairings losing authority); 6·6′ beneath; pointer repel/shove — correction refusing a pleasing reading.

#5→0 return — the constellation settles: 3:1 recognised, ◉ the body persisting, N·P the Name/Power relation, A29/A35 the return offices; pointer near-still attract. ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0 gathered five ambiguous images under an assistant's excited readings; #5→0 returns the same five as distinct offices with their corrections carried (the eagle signed, not reconciled; the wheels compounded; the wings primed; the Mother flow still bearing the body it received) — the cope's ambiguity is not resolved into symbolism but held as answerable image; ☽'s rise at #0, unguarded-seeming, answers at #5→0 where the maternal body is retained in what returns.

Human-amplified staging (binding flags kept): Taylor's corrections yes; the Sophia–Logos–Śakti fixed allocation and the Levinasian join no — both guards carried in the scene bodies and rationales. The Q27 Mother-flow correction governs; no lunar, fertility or resurrection symbolism attributed to the rabbit figure. Mythemic verbs only: the chiasm demonstrates the crossed reading; the corrections demonstrate authorship governing pattern.
